mutation_rule: Only the fleet observe arm writes this registry, replacing the snapshot for one runner_id per observation. No human or agent edits it by hand; drift is corrected by re-observing, not by editing.
placement_rule: Placement reads this registry and nothing else for runner usability. An absent or stale snapshot mutes the runner; silence never grants work. The refusal message must name the observe command.
purpose: Capacity registry for the fleet supervisor loop. Supervised state that placement trusts instead of cold probes.

snapshot_fields.disk_avail_bytes: nullable u64; null means unmeasured and mutes the runner
snapshot_fields.free_ram_bytes: nullable u64; null means unmeasured and mutes the runner
snapshot_fields.observed_unix_s: u64 epoch seconds of the observation
snapshot_fields.runner_id: node id from infra/registry.json (e.g. cynic-builder, cynic-compute-01)
snapshot_fields.state_root: nullable string; null means the runner reported no state root and mutes the runner

usability.degraded_when: free RAM below the task class floor
muted_when: snapshot older than the staleness window
